guidance: Use PSA LFS provincial annual employment rate; consider unemployment and underemployment rates as separate indicators where available.
Use CALABARZON share of national OFWs as the region-level OFW exposure signal. Do not label it regional remittance amount.

Employment data are province-level; SOF regional OFW data are Region IV-A-level. The same regional value may be joined to all five provinces only as an explicitly regional feature, not as five independent provincial measurements.
SOF is an annual survey reference window (April-September), not quarterly remittance flow. Avoid interpolating into quarterly values without a documented method.

No 2026 annual LFS or SOF outcome is available as of 6 November 2026. The 2026 LFS has monthly rounds, but special rounds are national-only for reliable estimates; regular rounds support regional estimates.
Missing cells are blank, not zero. Verify preliminary vs final status before model training.
